SHOT 09-01 | 0s–6s | 6 SECONDS
35mm calm front three-quarter medium-wide from northwest of Zahhak, looking southeast. Zahhak occupies the right foreground, torso facing north away from Jamshid; Jamshid stands distant left-center facing him, with his mask front visible. Zahhak turns his head only enough for a brief glance at Jamshid, then directs his eyes toward the east saw bay. Jamshid holds his upright expectation. Camera drifts forward slowly.
SHOT 09-02 | 6s–9s | 3 SECONDS
50mm from west, a tighter lateral composition retaining both Zahhak's hand and the distant saw bay. Zahhak supports himself on his staff and gives one small free-hand indication toward the saw. Guard A immediately begins turning Jamshid east. Zahhak's gaze has already left him.
SHOT 09-03 | 9s–12s | 3 SECONDS
35mm close handheld from west of the escort. A and B move Jamshid toward the east service bay. His torso tries to remain oriented north toward Zahhak while his feet are redirected east. Camera reacts to that bodily conflict.
SHOT 09-04 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS
28mm calm full figure from the west aisle. Zahhak turns north toward the balcony and takes one slow uneven step: plant staff, transfer weight, draw weaker leg forward. His shoulder snakes continue subtle living movement. The camera remains composed.
END STATE AND EDIT
Two paths have begun: Jamshid moves east with A and B; Zahhak moves north toward the balcony. C and D remain at the entrance. Preserve these directions through the following parallel cuts.

Quiet staff contact contrasts with the escort's faster shoes, sleeve friction and Jamshid's breathing. Harbor activity continues underneath.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
